OBJ-NULL-UNIF is 130816 iid draws whose 200-replicate sd matches sqrt(p(1-p)/n) to about 8 percent at every powered rung; OBJ-REAL IS NOT A SAMPLE - the frozen specification says so - and its 130816 values are determined by 512 factor-base x-coordinates each appearing in 511 pairs, n = C(512,2) = 130816 exactly.
